For starters I am a 24 year old at a healthy weight/BMI (23.1 and working hard to lose weight for aesthetic purposes only). I'm active and eat a very healthy diet with small indulgences here and there. I was recently diagnosed with hypoglycemia and B12 deficiency after experiencing unexplained fatigue, mood swings, headaches and constant hunger for months. Now when I say constant hunger that is not an exaggeration. My body does not produce enough glucose or iron so my brain is constantly telling my stomach to want more and more food, even if I've just eaten. Being a health conscious person I refuse to give in, to go way above the calories I can take in daily based on my BMR, and yes, I accept the fact that most of the time I feel hungry. I keep a detailed food log to make sure I'm eating properly, check my blood sugar regularly, and still workout so long as I have the energy to do at least 30 minutes of cardio. I don't make it to the gym every day but since I'm eating properly I can afford to miss a few workouts.

My body hasn't gone into "starvation mode" and I'm not oppressed simply because I want to make sure I am only eating what I need and not what I want.
